plan_review.notes: Round 1 rejected lifecycle fabrication and blurred authority; the revised plan separates PR facts from epic lifecycle, assigns one authority per contract, freezes field-level invariants and the existing 10-slot ability cap, keeps Unique external to the DAG, and orders ADR before specs/state. Round 2 found one wording gap, resolved by requiring materialize issue -> validator ready -> CLAIMED lease/base -> heartbeat/in_progress -> PR + HANDOFF -> pr_open.
